title: Love Asks Again
speaker: Ashley Evans

content.value: Peter’s failure was public. Restoration is too.
Jesus does not skip the wound. He walks him back through it.
The question is not “did you fail”. It is “do you love me.”
Love for Jesus always turns into care for people.
The proof of the conversation is what Peter does next.
Your calling is not cancelled because you failed.
Jesus ends where he began. Follow me.
The past is named. It is not the last word.

responsePrompts: Where is Jesus asking you the question again?
Who is he asking you to feed?
